* @param {params} params
* @param {api} params.api
* @param {any} params.event
* @param {any} params.imports
* @param {ApiHelpers} params.helpers
*/
function handler({api, event, helpers, imports}) {
    api.emit("NAV_ITEM_SELECTED", {
        route: "pages",
        params: {
            filter: api.context.props.filter,
            library: "dashboards"
        }
    });

    var roles = api.context &&
        api.context.session &&
        api.context.session.user &&
        api.context.session.user.roles || [];

    var ADMIN_ROLES = ["admin", "platform_analytics_admin", "dashboard_admin"];

    var isAdmin = roles.some(role => ADMIN_ROLES.includes(role));

    if (isAdmin) {
        api.setState("tourId", "596a7c2effe4721065f1ffffffffffae");
        api.setState("userId", api.context.session.user.sys_id);
    }
}]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-07 17:43:11</sys_created_on><sys_id>ffacd679a86a03107f446d9f3e09f6f4</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>On page load</sys_name><sys_package display_value="VisaGuardian AI" source="x_snc_visaguardi_0">8f250678982603107f447d1bb882e5ba</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="VisaGuardian AI">8f250678982603107f447d1bb882e5ba</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_ffacd679a86a03107f446d9f3e09f6f4</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-08-07 17:43:11</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>default</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>
